title: nullmoth/nvidia-macos-driver
why_read: An unofficial Metal driver bringing NVIDIA RTX GPU support back to macOS, a notable reverse-engineering feat since Apple dropped Nvidia support years ago.
analysis: This project provides a Metal graphics driver enabling NVIDIA GeForce RTX cards to work on macOS 15 Sequoia via Hackintosh-style OpenCore setups, something Apple has not officially supported since dropping Nvidia driver support years ago. Building a Metal driver for a GPU architecture Apple never endorsed requires serious low-level graphics and kernel driver reverse-engineering work. This is a niche but technically impressive hobbyist/community effort that will interest hackintosh and GPU driver enthusiasts.
